---
title: "What value to choose for theta?"
author: "Bram van Moorter"
date: "2022-12-05"
categories: [settings, topic guide]
---

In other words: "how random are paths between source and target?"

A difficult question... 

First, testing different values of $\theta$ will allow
you to assess the sensitivity of your results to this crucial parameter.

Several efforts exist to estimate $\theta$ from movement data, for instance: 
[Kivimäki et al. 2020](https://academic.oup.com/comnet/article-abstract/8/4/cnaa024/5989563), 
and [Panzacchi et al. 2015](https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/1365-2656.12386).
